[RCTS.1.1.3] **Several fixtures for one clause.** When one fixture cannot
exercise a clause fully (a positive and a negative case, two code paths),
each further fixture appends a suffix to the citation: a lowercase letter
(`LCDB.7.8a`), or `_` and a lowercase name saying what it pins
(`LFAC.2.5.1_tolerance_bound_inclusive`). Prefer one citation, one fixture.
